meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把 Mattermost 聊天服务接入当前项目:先查找本机已有的 Mattermost,没有就询问是否创建本地测试实例;随后引导完成服务器设置、机器人创建、回调配置,使私信、频道、审批卡片等能收发。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Mattermost 频道、配置 Mattermost 机器人,或把 Mattermost 接入项目时,Claude 会开始执行这个流程。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 频道
say.note: 开始查找已有服务器或询问远程地址。

say.text: 接入自托管的 Mattermost 服务器
say.note: 探测本机 8065 端口,让你确认服务器。

say.text: 创建本地 Mattermost 测试服务器
say.note: 检查 Docker 环境,征得同意后才安装。

howto.what_en: Claude helps connect Mattermost to the project: finds an existing local server, or offers a local test install if none; then guides server setup, bot creation, and callback config to enable DMs, channels, files, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or connect a Mattermost channel, configure a Mattermost bot, or integrate Mattermost into the project.

say_en.text: Help me add a Mattermost channel
say_en.note: Starts discovery or asks for a remote URL.

say_en.text: Connect the project to a self-hosted Mattermost
say_en.note: Probes localhost:8065 and asks you to confirm.

say_en.text: Create a local Mattermost evaluation server
say_en.note: Checks Docker and installs only after approval.
